title: Buenos Aires Government Reportedly Used Children's Personal Data in Facial Recognition System for Fugitives

behaviors.text: Beginning in April 2019, the Buenos Aires city government reportedly used data from Argentina’s CONARC fugitive database, including [person]’s identities and reference photos, in its live Facial Recognition System for Fugitives (SRFP).
Human Rights Watch found at least 166 [person] had appeared in CONARC between 2017 and 2020 and warned that the system exposed them to privacy violations and elevated risks of false matches.
